subject: FinTechCo onboarding: provisioning staging & IP gate kickoff
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fintechco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinTechCo onboarding: provisioning staging & IP gate kickoff

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Per our discussion I want to kick off the provisioning and IP allowlist gating work so we can get a staging cutover window scheduled next week. High-level agenda for this thread:

- Confirm SAML metadata and SP-ACS endpoints for staging
- SCIM group mapping & initial sync cadence (staging namespace)
- Staging CIDR(s) for allowlist + test traffic plan
- Service account naming & least-privilege patterns for automation
- Dry-run / canary rollback plan and timing

Action items for FinTechCo before our dry-run:
1) Send SAML metadata file (or IdP metadata URL) for your staging IdP
2) Provide the SCIM admin token for the staging tenant (we can accept a short-lived token)
3) Confirm one or two staging CIDRs you can temporarily open for our test run

I attached a short provisioning manifest template (fintechco_provisioning_manifest.csv) to capture the above details. If you prefer a call, I can book a 30-minute slot — otherwise I'll follow up with a proposed dry-run window once we have the metadata.

Thanks — looking forward to getting staging provisioned and validated.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: fintechco_provisioning_manifest.csv

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fintechco.com>

Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTechCo onboarding: provisioning staging & IP gate kickoff

Thanks Sean —

We've got the manifest and will fill it out today. A couple quick clarifications from our security team:

- For SAML, our staging SP-ACS URL is https://staging.app.fintechco.com/_saml/acs and we prefer SP-initiated flows for user-facing login tests. We will attach our IdP metadata in a follow-up email (security lead wants to scrub a couple of cert metadata lines).
- SCIM: groups are namespaced under "fintechco:engineering" vs "fintechco:prod" — we want to ensure only the engineering groups sync to staging. Can you confirm Redwood's SCIM filter support (group prefix/regex)?
- IP allowlist: we can open 198.51.100.0/24 for the staging window and can provide an alternate CIDR if needed.
- Service accounts: we will require explicit service account names in the manifest and a requirement for short-lived tokens where possible.

Two availability notes: we can do a dry-run window on Tue 11 May 09:00-11:00 PT or Wed 12 May 13:00-15:00 PT — which works better from your side?

Laura Chen
Head of Infrastructure, FinTechCo
laura.chen@fintechco.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fintechco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTechCo onboarding: provisioning staging & IP gate kickoff

Laura — great, thanks for the quick responses and the proposed windows. Wed 12 May 13:00-15:00 PT works best for our engineering team; I'll pencil it in and send an invite once we have the SCIM token.

Wanted to summarize the engineering checklist so everyone has a single reference (I'm copying the manifest rows below as guidance):

SAML
- Need: IdP metadata XML (or HTTPS metadata URL) + assertion Consumer (SP-ACS) URL (you listed https://staging.app.fintechco.com/_saml/acs)
- Test scope: SP-initiated login + sample user with email domain @fintechco.com
- Note: we recommend SHA-256 certs; if your IdP uses multiple signing certs we can accept metadata with both certs.

SCIM
- Need: SCIM admin bearer token scoped to select groups
- Filter support: Redwood supports group prefix filters and regex allowlist for group.displayName — please indicate the prefix (e.g., "fintechco:engineering").
- Initial sync: schedule a manual sync during dry-run, then enable nightly delta sync if you want continuous sync for staging.

IP ALLOWLIST
- Suggested staging CIDR for our test traffic: 198.51.100.0/24 (you confirmed availability)
- We'll also perform a quick egress check from your staging to ensure callback webhooks reach 198.51.100.0/24

SERVICE ACCOUNTS / TOKENS
- Please list service account IDs in the manifest. Pattern we recommend: fintechco-staging-rls-<role>-<env> (e.g., fintechco-staging-rls-provisioner)
- We support short-lived tokens via our provisioning endpoint. If you require KMS-backed credentials, note that in the manifest and we'll enable the HSM-backed key path on the tenant.

DRY-RUN / CANARY PLAN
- Plan: provision staging tenant + apply SAML metadata + run manual SCIM sync -> smoke test with 3 sample users -> run 5-minute load from 3 IPs inside the agreed CIDR -> validate logs & audit entries -> flip small subset of traffic for canary (if applicable)
- Rollback: remove SAML SP binding and revert routing, invalidate any staging service account tokens issued during the run. We'll record timestamps and a rollback point in the runbook.

Attachments I will include: fintechco_saml-metadata.xml (example SP metadata for Redwood) and a filled provisioning manifest template.

Please attach your IdP metadata and the SCIM token when available and we'll finalize the invite.

—Sean

Attachments: fintechco_saml-metadata.xml, fintechco_provisioning_manifest.csv

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fintechco.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTechCo onboarding: provisioning staging & IP gate kickoff

Hi all —

Engineering will own the cutover execution for the dry-run on Wed 12 May 13:00-15:00 PT. A few operational notes from our side so FinTechCo knows what to expect:

1) Environment names: staging-redwood-ftco-01 (provisioning target), staging-redwood-ftco-01-canary (small traffic slice). Please do not reuse the prod naming convention in staging.
2) Runbook snapshot: we'll follow a checklist and log entries to the shared Drive document. If we detect a misconfiguration in SAML assertion mapping (missing NameID format or attribute), we will pause and request a config change rather than proceed.
3) Audit & logs: we will capture token issuance events and SCIM sync deltas. Expect an audit export (CSV) within 2 hours post-run for your security review.
4) Service account gating: we will not issue persistent service account tokens until after final signoff. Any tokens used for the dry-run will be revoked immediately after the window.

Please upload the IdP metadata and a scoped SCIM token to the Drive link (https://drive.redwood.com/fintechco/onboarding/runbook-v1) and reply if you'd prefer we convert the staging CIDR to a single IP for a more constrained test.

I'll send the calendar invite with Zoom + runbook link once we have the SCIM token.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
